node_definition_in_the_graph: The amulet of udumbara wood, worn in AVS 19.31 for prosperity, cattle and fatness in the cow-stall, and addressed as prosperity itself. All seven occurrences are in that one hymn.
sense_of_every_line: Udumbara WOOD. The audumbari post of the sadas, the audumbara camasa, the audumbari asandi, the audumbara danda, the audumbara paridhi, the audumbara plough. Not one line is an amulet.
why_this_is_not_a_count_error: The count is correct for the alias and wrong for the node. `audumbara` in the ritual apparatus is the wood; the node is the AVS 19.31 amulet, whose own definition says all seven occurrences are in that one hymn. Re-deriving the count from the same alias would reproduce the same 91.
absence_is_typed_not_zeroed: The corrected properties record that 91 lines were assessed and 0 attest the amulet, so a reader can tell an assessed zero from an unexamined one. Setting the count to 0 alone would read as `nobody looked`.
